cases.request: how do i make banana bread
cases.reply: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and grease a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan. Mash three very ripe bananas in a large bowl. Stir in a third of a cup of melted butter until combined. Mix in one teaspoon of baking soda and a pinch of salt. Add three quarters of a cup of sugar, one beaten egg, and one teaspoon of vanilla. Fold in one and a half cups of flour until just combined, without overmixing. Pour the batter into the pan and bake for 55 to 65 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. Let it cool in the pan for 10 minutes before turning it out onto a rack. Optional add-ins like walnuts or chocolate chips can go in with the flour.
